title: Useless...
text: Useless.... What a disappointment!  I was so looking forward to placing these artificial succulent plants on my dining room table.  That isn't going to happen, unfortunately. They're incredibly artificial looking-they don't look the least bit real.  One of the pots arrived completely cracked from one side of the pot, all the way to the other side.  Pieces of the pot had broken off as well.  The small pebbles are not very secure and I lost quite a few  even though I gently removed the pots from the packaging when they arrived.  Broken pot, missing stones, not realistic looking....I really don't have any use for these now.  (Unable to post photos at this time, will check back and if/when the issue is fixed, will post photos of the plants/broken pot/missing stones)
